title: made my first game at 18, you dig through a giant haystack looking for one needle. would love your feedback
author: Optimal-Shine9663
selftext:
ive wanted to make a game for years and this is the first one i actually finished. a few weeks ago i saw that clip of Needle In A Haystack Simulator, the one with like 50 million views, and the steam game isnt out yet. i couldnt stop thinking about it, so i tried making my own version to play right now.

you start with bare hands and dig tunnels through a giant 3D haystack. you find old coins, keys, watches, the odd diamond, sell them, and upgrade all the way up to a Hay Vacuum 3000. later you get a metal detector that beeps faster as you get close, and little machines that dig for you. then one day you find the needle.

im 18 and still learning. i used AI tools alot and i wont hide that, but i wrote alot of the code by hand too, and how it works and the mechanics (tunnels that stay, hay that falls when it loses support) came from me trying stuff until it felt right.

some people called it AI slop or a copy and that stung, because i put real effort into it. its inspired by the clip, i said that from day one, and its free while we wait for the real one.

if you try it, i would love to know what you would add. ideas, tools, anything that felt off. im reading every comment and i want to build the good ones.

and if you find the needle, tell me how long it took :)

[https://findingneedleinthestack.com](https://findingneedleinthestack.com/) (free, works on phone)

thanks for reading, it really means a lot.
